# Calkilo

> Calkilo is an AI calorie counter and nutrition assistant for editable food-photo estimates, macro tracking, daily food logs, and meal planning.

Calkilo is available for iOS and Android. It supports English, Persian, Italian, Dutch, Russian, Chinese, and Arabic public landing content.

## Official product pages

- [Home](https://calkilo.com/): Overview of the Calkilo nutrition app and its photo-first food logging workflow.
- [About Calkilo](https://calkilo.com/about/): Product purpose, audience, workflow, and important limitations.
- [Features](https://calkilo.com/features/): Photo calorie estimates, macro tracking, meal planning, and integrations.
- [Pricing](https://calkilo.com/pricing/): Current monthly and yearly premium plans.
- [FAQ](https://calkilo.com/faq/): Subscriptions, privacy, device sync, AI food logging, and support.
- [Blog](https://calkilo.com/blog/): Localized nutrition and product education articles.

## Calculators and tools

- [Daily calorie calculator](https://calkilo.com/calorie-calculator/): Estimate daily calories, TDEE, and a weight-goal timeline.
- [BMI calculator](https://calkilo.com/bmi-calculator/): Calculate adult BMI and understand the limits of the measurement.
- [Photo calorie calculator](https://calkilo.com/photo-calorie-calculator/): How to estimate meal calories and macros from a food photo.
- [Uber Eats nutrition calculator](https://calkilo.com/uber-eats-nutrition-calculator/): Estimate nutrition from an Uber Eats menu-item URL.

## Product guides

- [AI calorie tracker](https://calkilo.com/ai-calorie-tracker/): Calkilo AI-assisted food logging and nutrition tracking.
- [Macro tracker](https://calkilo.com/macro-tracker/): Track protein, carbohydrates, fat, and calories together.
- [AI meal planner for weight loss](https://calkilo.com/ai-meal-planner-for-weight-loss/): Connect targets, meal logging, and practical planning.
- [Calorie counter for Persian food](https://calkilo.com/best-calorie-counter-for-persian-food/): Tracking Iranian mixed dishes and portions.
- [Calkilo vs MyFitnessPal](https://calkilo.com/calkilo-vs-myfitnesspal/): A workflow-focused comparison with explicit estimate limitations.

## Persian resources

- [Food calorie database](https://calkilo.com/fa/calories/): Persian recipes and 7,793 USDA samples with crawlable categories, nutrition tables and portion calculations.
- [Food data sources](https://calkilo.com/fa/calories/sources/): Data provenance, historical reference version, units, missing values and portion calculation methodology.
- [Persian homepage](https://calkilo.com/fa/): Persian-language product overview.
- [Persian photo calorie calculator](https://calkilo.com/fa/photo-calorie-calculator/): Persian guide to photo calorie estimation.
- [Persian daily tracker](https://calkilo.com/fa/ai-calorie-tracker/): Review daily calorie and macro records in the app.
- [Kebab calorie example](https://calkilo.com/fa/calories/kebab/): Example nutrition ranges and portion factors for kebab.
- [Rice calorie example](https://calkilo.com/fa/calories/rice/): Example nutrition ranges and portion factors for rice.

## Important limitations

- Food-photo analysis produces estimates, not laboratory measurements.
- Portion size, oils, sauces, hidden ingredients, recipes, and image quality can change an estimate.
- Users should review and correct results before saving them.
- Calkilo is not a substitute for medical advice or a prescribed therapeutic diet.
